content.text: The discount is applied as a fraction of the total but the test passes the percentage as a whole number, so ten percent becomes a factor of ten and the result goes negative. I have checked the three callers of apply_discount and each of them passes a whole-number percentage, which means the safest fix is to divide by one hundred inside apply_discount rather than touching any caller or any test fixture in the repository.
